mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (id, group_id, sender_user_id, type, content, created_at) VALUES (#{message.id}, #{message.groupId}, #{message.senderUserId}, #{message.type}, #{message.content}, #{message.createdAt})

INSERT INTO chat_attachment (id, message_id, content_type, width, height, byte_size, data) VALUES (#{attachment.id}, #{attachment.messageId}, #{attachment.contentType}, #{attachment.width}, #{attachment.height}, #{attachment.byteSize}, #{attachment.data})
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chat_message WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND id = #{messageId})

SELECT page.* FROM ( SELECT m.id, m.sender_user_id, users.nickname AS sender_nickname, m.type, m.content, m.created_at, attachment.id AS attachment_id, attachment.content_type AS attachment_content_type, attachment.width AS attachment_width, attachment.height AS attachment_height, attachment.byte_size AS attachment_byte_size FROM chat_message m JOIN app_user users ON users.id = m.sender_user_id LEFT JOIN chat_attachment attachment ON attachment.message_id = m.id WHERE m.group_id = #{groupId}
AND (m.created_at, m.id) < (SELECT cursor.created_at, cursor.id FROM chat_message cursor WHERE cursor.group_id = #{groupId} AND cursor.id = #{beforeMessageId})
AND (m.created_at, m.id) > (SELECT cursor.created_at, cursor.id FROM chat_message cursor WHERE cursor.group_id = #{groupId} AND cursor.id = #{afterMessageId})
ORDER BY m.created_at, m.id ORDER BY m.created_at DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) page ORDER BY page.created_at, page.id
